description:
**Req ID:** 377770
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Engineers (Agentic / Automation) to join our team in Gurgaon, Haryāna (IN\-HR), India (IN).
  
  

**Job Summary:**  

Agentic/ Automation Engineer .NET (C\#), Python, some Java; Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen or similar);
  
MCP (Model Context Protocol); API\-first development; REST/event\-driven integration.
  
AWS (Lambda, S3, SQS); registry/orchestration patterns
  
  

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior .NET Engineer with 8\+ years of experience in designing, developing, and supporting scalable enterprise applications and integrations. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in C\# / .NET Core, REST API development, event\-driven architecture, and AWS services including Lambda, S3, SQS, and RDS. Experience integrating with iLEVEL and internal workflow tools is essential. The role requires a strong backend engineering mindset, excellent problem\-solving skills, and the ability to build reliable, secure, and maintainable systems in a cloud\-based environment.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Design, develop, and maintain robust backend applications using C\# and .NET Core
* Build and enhance scalable REST APIs for internal and external system integrations
* Develop and support integrations with iLEVEL and internal workflow tools
* Design and implement solutions using event\-driven architecture principles
* Work with AWS services including Lambda, S3, SQS, and RDS to build and support cloud\-native solutions
* Collaborate with product managers, business analysts, architects, and cross\-functional engineering teams
* Translate business and integration requirements into scalable technical solutions
* Ensure application performance, reliability, security, and maintainability
* Build reusable components and services for integration\-heavy environments
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement fixes
* Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical design sessions
* Contribute to testing, deployment, and operational readiness activities
* Create and maintain technical documentation for APIs, integrations, and workflows
* Mentor junior team members and support engineering best practices


**Required Skills and Qualifications:**  

* 8\+ years of software development experience with strong backend engineering expertise
* Strong hands\-on experience with C\# and .NET Core
* Proven experience in REST API development
* Experience integrating enterprise systems, including iLEVEL and internal workflow tools
* Strong understanding of event\-driven architecture
* Hands\-on experience with AWS, specifically:
* Lambda
* S3
* SQS
* RDS
* Strong knowledge of application integration patterns and service\-oriented design
* Experience with relational databases and backend data processing
* Familiarity with secure coding standards and API security best practices
* Experience with source control systems such as Git
* Knowledge of unit testing, integration testing, and debugging practices
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem\-solving skills


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience in financial services, investment systems, or workflow\-driven enterprise platforms
* Familiarity with message\-based processing and asynchronous workflows
* Experience with cloud monitoring and logging tools in AWS environments
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
* Understanding of domain\-driven design, microservices, or distributed system concepts
* Experience documenting and managing system integrations in complex enterprise ecosystems


**Key Competencies:**  

* Backend engineering and API development
* Enterprise application integration
* Event\-driven system design
* Cloud\-native development on AWS
* Reliability, scalability, and performance optimization
* Strong ownership and delivery focus
* Cross\-functional collaboration and technical leadership


**Sample Tech Stack:**  

* Backend: C\#, .NET Core
* Integration: REST APIs, iLEVEL, Internal Workflow Tools
* Architecture: Event\-Driven Architecture
* Cloud: AWS Lambda, S3, SQS, RDS


**Education:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred
